title: ARMIC
tagline: ARMIC is a Platform that fuses advanced robotics, Blockchain and AI Agents to transform patient rehabilitation.

description:
Team ARMIC is a group of biomedical engineers passionate about merging AI, blockchain, and robotics to revolutionize rehabilitation. With ARMIC, we were inspired by mirror therapy, a rehabilitation technique that helps patients regain motor function by creating the illusion of movement in an impaired limb. We saw an opportunity to enhance this approach using AI agents and blockchain. Our platform personalizes rehabilitation routines through AI while leveraging blockchain for secure and transparent progress tracking. By integrating robotics, smart contracts, and tokenized incentives, ARMIC ensures patient engagement and accurate therapy execution. This fusion of cutting-edge technology with medical rehabilitation is our step toward a more intelligent, accessible, and efficient recovery process. 

We hope you enjoy our project!
how_its_made: In this project, we primarily used Base's technologies as the main blockchain, thanks to its transaction speed and low costs, we were able to run our project on mainnet. AgentKit from Coinbase Developer Platform as SDK to connect our AI Agents to IoT devices through transactions on the blockchain. Something we would like to mention was the adaptation of AgentKit to work with any LLM model through Ollama, since all the examples shown of how to use this toolkit were using LLMs through API.
